welcome_text: Hello! My name is Ingrid Bianchi
who_i_am: From commercial strategist to full-stack developer with UX vision.

After years optimizing retail operations and leading multidisciplinary teams, I channeled my passion for efficiency into tech development. Today, I merge user-centered design with robust web development to create high-impact digital solutions.
My unique value: 360° vision (from UX mockups to deployment), e-commerce & CRM systems expertise, business-to-technical translation skills, and agile performance-focused methodologies.
What inspires me: transforming wireframes into interactive systems, building efficient backend architectures, and delivering seamless end-to-end experiences.
